documents.text: 26 Feb. 1662 , and the bill passed the Lower House , but was rejected by the Lords . However , the case inspired the Gaming Act of 1665 . Scudamore was reluctant to act without ‘ Daddy ’ s advice ’ , but welcomed the second Dutch war as an opportunity to assuage his restlessness by serving with the fleet . Nevertheless he was conscientious in attending quarter sessions . He died in his father ’ s lifetime on 18 June 1668 , and was buried at Holme Lacy . 4 Ref Volumes : 1660-1690 Author : Edward Rowlands
